ans.settings.title: Actions & Stuff Settings
ans.settings.missing: No pack settings found: run the converter (work/converter/convert.py)
ans.settings.experience: Experience §8Full Experience: the pack's own textures for mobs, items and armour. Vanilla Experience: vanilla-style textures with the pack's animations. Blocks, item icons and GUI: the "Actions & Stuff Textures" resource pack.
text.oreville_ans.pbvovd: Biome Mob Variants §8Controls how biome-specific mob variants can appear.
text.oreville_ans.qbytoo: Spawn Naturally and by Name Tag
text.oreville_ans.mihbmn: Morph §8Replaces the default player model with a custom Actions & Stuff model (only you see it).
text.oreville_ans.wtaqxt: Axolotl Color §8Changes the color of the axolotl in a bucket.
text.oreville_ans.wfwwna: Armor Visibility §8Controls whether armor is shown on the player.
text.oreville_ans.utfxjc: Enchanted Tool Look §8Controls how enchanted tools look in hand.
text.oreville_ans.rrtbvo: Enchant Color §8Controls the color of the enchantment glow and outline.
text.oreville_ans.bmendx: Totem Translucency §8Controls when a Totem of Undying becomes translucent in first person.
text.oreville_ans.msjzgl: Expressions §8Blinking eyes and eyebrows on player skins. Turn this off if your skin looks wrong.
text.oreville_ans.aqwcjr: Costumes §8Turns trimmed leather armor into costumes (Full Experience textures only).
text.oreville_ans.ljwzdo: Item Switch Sounds §8Plays a sound when switching items in the hotbar.
text.oreville_ans.qgoyax: Better Rain Particles §8Switches between the custom and the vanilla rain particles.
text.oreville_ans.pboqzn: Classic Baby Chicken §8Switches between the classic Actions & Stuff baby chicken and the new Tiny Takeover baby chicken.
